item.title: Mysterious dark matter may be better understood through a new map of far-off galaxies
item.description: By ADITHI RAMAKRISHNAN NEW YORK (AP) — A new high-resolution map of distant galaxies may help scientists understand a mysterious invisible substance that helps hold the universe together. The ordinary matter all around us — stars, planets and people — makes up just 5% of the universe. item.description: By MICHAEL R.
